pinDeltas.behavior: The main baseline adds the drag-driven 32-content-column file projection boundary and nested src/ui fixtures.
The main baseline makes the bundled files width a clamped 16 percent response until a user drag establishes an override, and isolates the top-pane width from the files slot.

testMappings.upstream: resizes the default sidebar with the terminal until the user drags it
dragging the divider rightward widens the sidebar
resizing across the content-width threshold switches the file projection
dragging the divider far left clamps the sidebar at its minimum width
dragging a horizontal divider resizes a top pane on the row axis
a mouse release with no active drag leaves the layout unchanged
a non-left mouse button on the divider does not start a resize

adaptations: The bundled Files registration now participates in the same Ratatui pane plan, override map, divider hit area, and drag capture as native extension panes.
Non-pager review bodies reserve the pinned one-cell gutter on each side, so a 240-column terminal plans a 238-column pane canvas and places the responsive files divider at column 39.
The host-owned Files renderer receives the planned raw pane width while reserving two columns before choosing the flat or tree projection, reproducing the 31 versus 32 content-cell boundary.
